yorum: The hotel and the sea are perfect

Right on the beach. Welcomed by owner to this great hotel. Victoria and husband always checking guests happy and all going well. I cannot praise them enough. Happy to book our airport transfer. Building and rooms cleaned to high standard daily. Great room with everything you could need, and we had fabulous views. Safe much larger than those normally found in hotels. Hotels all seemed to play fairly loud music. Respite in our room though which blocked most noise out. We slept very we Extensive buffet breakfast. Chef still available for requests like soft poached eggs !!! Very good value. A very good place for an early season break.

Another holiday at the Zest, can't recommend it highly enough and will be returning in June. The hotel is right on the beach, the rooms are spotless and spacious (with tea making facility), sheets and towels are changed every two days. Excellent breakfast with great choice of food. You can have lunch and evening meal at the Rocca restaurant at the hotel or go to many of the other places to eat along the seafront. The dolmus (minibus) stops outside the hotel for the 25 minute journey into Bodrum. The hotel can arrange for a taxi pick up at Bodrum airport for independent travellers. Many members of staff have been here for years which is a recommendation in itself. Thank you Victoria and Mustapha for another wonderful stay at the Zest.

Hello, very hygienic, seafront,(2 minutes further than rooms) excellent service also the owner is Victoria from England, Her Husband is Turkish and has wonderful hospitality 🙏💜🇬🇧🇹🇷 we prepared to eat dinner hotel’s restaurant, excellent chef, seafood was incredible. Highly recommend Thanks
Proximity to the beach, couldn't be closer 4 or 5 steps to sunbed. Spa on site. Excellent staff really went above and beyond.

Stayed in this hotel for 1 week and we never had a dull moment. Everything was so smooth from the moment we checked in until to the last day. Staffs are so easy to talk, very friendly and helpful. Room is clean. Breakfast is scrumptious. Our room was facing the pool and the sea is overlooking. It was a lovely view. Our room’s balcony is huge and very relaxing to spend some time sitting and looking around. This place is perfect to those who want to relax and enjoy their vacation. Not a typical crowded place. Pool is clean and everyone can stay there as long as they want without getting any itching. I highly recommend this place to everyone. We will definitely book at this property again when we come back Bodrum. A lovely stay indeed!

Great hotel on the beach which provide sun beds for guests use. Checkin was efficient and we were given the rooms previous requested. Bathroom was a decent size with a lovely walk-in shower. Rooms were serviced daily. All areas were spotless and the staff very friendly. Breakfast was a continental buffet but you could order a cooked breakfast. Good menu selection and meze. We ate at the hotel several times but also tried other restaurants along the front. We caught the bus into Bodrum and enjoyed a great lunch above the harbour and below the castle. Good shopping in the covered market. Highly recommend this hotel and if in the area would certainly stay here again.

A+ Cleaning of rooms & change of linen & towels daily Really cannot fault Mustafa & Victoria with their team Thank You for a wonderful holiday! X
Amazing property. Very clean, right on a sandy beach, and great staff. We stayed for 5 nights and enjoyed every second of it.

We were so lucky to book at Zest. Not knowing the area we went on the great reviews, and how right they were. Great boutique hotel with modern comfortable rooms. Immaculately clean and run by a great team led by Vicky. Added bonus, the in house restaurant was superb. Thank you Vicky for our stay, we’ll be back to see you soon
Relaxing stay in a modern, clean hotel. Little bit of maintenance needed to rooms but very pleasant and one of the few hotels open so early in the season (late April)
excellent especially because this was not a touristic season. So we enjoyed the entire beauty of the water, beach and the facility. Great staff; helpful and polite highly recommended

We stayed 3 nights at Zest in a family suite, Yesil Limon, whose balcony faces the boardwalk and the beach. The room was very well designed, clean, spacious, and pretty much perfect. The staff is super friendly and helpful. Breakfast is generous and the restaurant is quite good. The beach/sea is also super clean. We will re-book it when we visit Bodrum!
Delightful hotel Lovely room and great access to the sea...helpful staff and near lots of restaurants. We really enjoyed our stay.
